1: // Simple endless side‑scroll game for canvas with id "game"
2: (function(){
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if(!canvas) return; // canvas must exist
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   const w = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800;
7:   const h = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 400;
8:   // player ship
9:   const ship = {x:50, y:h/2-15, w:30, h:30, dy:0, speed:3};
10:   // asteroid pool
11:   const asteroids=[];
12:   let frame=0, score=0, gameOver=false;
13:   // keyboard handling
14:   const keys={};
15:   window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>keys[e.key]=true);
16:   window.addEventListener('keyup',e=>keys[e.key]=false);
17:   function spawn(){
18:     const size = 20+Math.random()*30;
19:     asteroids.push({x:w, y:Math.random()*(h-size), w:size, h:size, speed:2+Math.random()*3});
20:   }
21:   function update(){
22:     if(gameOver) return;
23:     // move ship
24:     if(keys['ArrowUp']) ship.y-=ship.speed;
25:     if(keys['ArrowDown']) ship.y+=ship.speed;
26:     if(keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.x-=ship.speed;
27:     if(keys['ArrowRight']) ship.x+=ship.speed;
28:     ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(h-ship.h, ship.y));
29:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(w-ship.w, ship.x));
30:     // spawn asteroids
31:     if(frame%60===0) spawn();
32:     // move asteroids
33:     for(let i=asteroids.length-1;i>=0;i--){
34:       const a=asteroids[i];
35:       a.x-=a.speed;
36:       // remove off‑screen
37:       if(a.x+a.w<0) {asteroids.splice(i,1); score++;}
38:       // collision check
39:       if(a.x < ship.x+ship.w && a.x+a.w > ship.x && a.y < ship.y+ship.h && a.y+a.h > ship.y){
40:         gameOver=true;
41:       }
42:     }
43:     frame++;
44:   }
45:   function draw(){
46:     ctx.clearRect(0,0,w,h);
47:     // draw ship
48:     ctx.fillStyle='cyan';
49:     ctx.fillRect(ship.x, ship.y, ship.w, ship.h);
50:     // draw asteroids
51:     ctx.fillStyle='gray';
52:     asteroids.forEach(a=>ctx.fillRect(a.x, a.y, a.w, a.h));
53:     // draw score
54:     ctx.fillStyle='white';
55:     ctx.font='16px sans-serif';
56:     ctx.fillText('Score: '+score,10,20);
57:     if(gameOver){
58:       ctx.fillStyle='red';
59:       ctx.font='30px sans-serif';
60:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', w/2-80, h/2);
61:     }
62:   }
63:   function loop(){
64:     update();
65:     draw();
66:     if(!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
67:   }
68:   loop();
69: })();
